thread:
alice: Quick preflight for apac-sat-01. Posting a minimal checklist + a couple of known triage steps so SRE can sign off before we enable GPU autoscale. Please run the checks below and paste outputs.

- Basic checklist: controlplane reachable, node kubelet status, image pull success, network MTU, BGP/route propagation, NTP drift <5s, node cert expiry >30d, GPU driver + CUDA validated.
- Cost note: start with reservation=4 gpus, don't scale to full 64 until autoscaler metrics steady :warning:.

ben: I'm on it. Will run node health and net tests now.

charlie: last time we saw weird pod pull slowness because of a mismatched MTU between overlay (vxlan) and physical NICs. Watch for RX/TX errors on the nodes.

infra-bot: Deploy job "region-config-apac-sat-01" finished (ci/infra-pipeline) :package:

ben: running quick commands, posting outputs.
```bash
# check kube node status
kubectl get nodes -o wide | egrep "Ready|NotReady"
# check NIC errors and MTU
ssh node-01 "ip -s link show eth0; ethtool -k eth0"
# throughput test (peer in same dc)
iperf3 -c 10.0.7.2 -P 4 -t 10
```

ben: node status: 18 Ready, 2 NotReady (node-17, node-19). Both NotReady show kubelet crashloop, investigating.

charlie: paste from node-17 NIC stats: "RX packets 12345678 errors 452 dropped 0 overruns 0 frame 0" — RX errors high. MTU on eth0 = 9000, but overlay MTU negotiated to 1500.

alice: that matches earlier note. If overlay/underlay MTU mismatch, large image pulls/tcp segmentation can stall. Quick mitigation: set kube-proxy and CNI to 1500 or set NIC MTU to 1500 temporarily. Prefer changing CNI tunnel MTU if possible.

dana: @alice, which runbook page has the exact commands?

alice: use runbook snippet below (also linked): https://intranet.redwood.ai/runbooks/apac-preflight

Snippet:
```bash
# set interface MTU (temporary, reboots required for persistent)
sudo ip link set dev eth0 mtu 1500
# restart kubelet on node
sudo systemctl restart kubelet
# redeploy cni with adjusted MTU env
kubectl -n kube-system set env daemonset/cilium TUNNEL_MTU=1400
```

ben: applied mtu change to node-17 and restarted kubelet; node reports Ready again. node-19 still NotReady, looks like driver crash on GPU init. Logs: "nvidia-smi: NVML initialization failed".

eve: GPU driver crash — is this the 515 vs 525 mismatch we saw before?

charlie: checking node-19 /var/log/nvidia-installer.log -> shows package conflict with kernel-5.10. Patch note: some older nodes need DKMS rebuild.

alice: mitigation plan: cordon node-19, drain non-critical pods, attempt DKMS rebuild + reboot. If fails, demote from initial pool and file a follow-up for image baking.

ben: draining now: `kubectl drain node-19 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` :arrow_down_small:

infra-bot: Alert: image-pull-backoff spikes in namespace ml-train observed for 8m — 12 pods affected.

eve: that likely from MTU earlier causing registry connections to time out. Now that some nodes recovered, pods are rescheduling.

dana: cost/ops question: we should gate scaling GPU nodes until all nodes pass health checks + image pull success for 15m. Agree? :+1:

alice: yes — gate is: (1) all nodes Ready, (2) registry success rate >99% for 15m, (3) autoscaler test passes (scale to +2 nodes then back). I'll hold the reservation bump.

charlie: FYI — found one edge case for on-prem networking: jumbo frames enabled on switch but not on uplink to router — causes fragmented traffic to be dropped. Added to known-issues list.

alice: updated runbook note: "If you see high RX errors + image pull timeouts, check physical switch MTU on the leaf/uplink and VXLAN tunnel MTU. Temporary fix: set node MTU to 1500 until switch config can be corrected."

ben: node-19 DKMS rebuild succeeded, rebooted, GPU driver loaded, `nvidia-smi` OK.

infra-bot: Autoscaler dry-run succeeded: simulated scale up/down for test-group-gpu, no exceptions.

dana: handing off to ops-oncall for final validation and cost approval. @dana please run the autoscaler smoke: create a job to push 30% GPU utilization and watch scaling.

dana: starting the smoke load now. Will report in 10m.

eve: small PR suggestion for runbook: add explicit backout commands for driver reverts and kubelet restart sequence. Saved me time last time.

alice: good call — I added a section "quick rollback" and pinned kernel/driver versions to the doc.

ben: all checks green, registry pull success 99.8% over last 20m, autoscaler smoke passed.

alice: thanks team. Handoff complete — leaving ticket RED-OPS-2026 open for 24h watch and cost review. :white_check_mark:
